parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around a pivot point to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout and switch, channels water from the inlet to the spout, and provides stability when mounted.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the outlet part of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream from the faucet to the sink or basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel or remain fixed depending on the faucet design, allowing directional control of water flow.
